gloss: to push down; to knock down; to shove over

definitions.gloss: to push down; to knock down; to shove over
definitions.explanation: To shove or thrust at a person so hard that they fall to the ground. Compound of {突|つ}く (to thrust) + {倒|たお}す (to knock down). The person pushed is marked with を.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}を{突|つ}き{倒|たお}す。
{彼|かれ}はぶつかってきた{男|おとこ}を{突|つ}き{倒|たお}した。
examples.english: He shoved down the man who bumped into him.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{混雑|こんざつ}で、{後|うし}ろから{人|ひと}に{突|つ}き{倒|たお}されそうになった。
examples.english: In the crowd at the station, I was nearly shoved over from behind.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). The person pushed is marked with を. Compound of {突|つ}く (to thrust) + {倒|たお}す (to knock down).

USAGE:
Emphasizes a violent, forceful push that knocks someone off their feet, stronger than plain {押|お}す (to push).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {力|ちから}いっぱい{突|つ}き{倒|たお}す: to shove down with all one's force
- {地面|じめん}に{突|つ}き{倒|たお}す: to knock down to the ground
